info.title: dotsider
info.description: A TUI for analyzing .NET assemblies — structure, metadata, IL, strings, dependencies, and more.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: dotsider — .NET assembly analysis TUI and CLI

commands.name: agent
commands.description: MCP server and agent skill file management

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialize an agent skill file for dotsider

options.name: --stdout
options.description: Write skill content to stdout instead of a file

options.name: --embedded-source
options.description: Print embedded source for a method (format: Type.Method)

options.name: --deps
options.description: Show assembly references and dependency graph

options.name: --min-len
options.description: Minimum length for raw string extraction (default: 4) [default: 4]

options.name: --symbols
options.description: List native symbols (Native AOT and other native binaries)

options.name: --why
options.description: Explain why a type or method is in a Native AOT binary (requires mstat and DGML sidecars)

options.name: --correlate
options.description: Correlate a Native AOT binary with its pre-ILC assembly. Bare: print correlation counts. With a value (Type.Method or 0xVA): print IL and native code side by side.

options.name: --r2r-correlate
options.description: Correlate a ReadyToRun image's managed methods with their precompiled native code. Bare: print precompiled-method stats. With a value (Type.Method, 0xTOKEN, or 0xVA): print IL and native code together.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write output to a file instead of stdout

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Assembly or native module to analyze (.dll, .exe, or .wasm)

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Compare two assemblies or AOT build sizes side-by-side

arguments.name: LEFT
arguments.description: First assembly, AOT binary, or .mstat size report

arguments.name: RIGHT
arguments.description: Second assembly, AOT binary, or .mstat size report

commands.name: capture
commands.description: Capture the TUI screen as plain text

arguments.name: PID
arguments.description: Process ID of the dotsider instance

commands.name: info
commands.description: Show assembly info and current view for a running instance

arguments.name: PID
arguments.description: Process ID of the dotsider instance

commands.name: navigate
commands.description: Switch to a specific tab in a running instance

arguments.name: PID
arguments.description: Process ID of the dotsider instance

arguments.name: TAB
arguments.description: Tab to navigate to (1=General, 2=PE/Metadata, 3=IL / Native, 4=Strings, 5=Hex Dump, 6=Dep Graph, 7=Size Map, 8=Dynamic)

commands.name: trace
commands.description: Trace commands for a running instance

commands.name: counters
commands.description: Get performance counters from a running instance

arguments.name: PID
arguments.description: Process ID of the dotsider instance

commands.name: events
commands.description: Get trace events from a running instance

options.name: --category
options.description: Filter by event category (jit, gc, exception, loader, contention)

options.name: --max
options.description: Maximum number of events to return

arguments.name: PID
arguments.description: Process ID of the dotsider instance

commands.name: output
commands.description: Get process output from a running instance

arguments.name: PID
arguments.description: Process ID of the dotsider instance

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start tracing in a running instance

arguments.name: PID
arguments.description: Process ID of the dotsider instance

arguments.name: ARGUMENTS
arguments.description: Literal arguments for the traced process

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop tracing in a running instance

arguments.name: PID
arguments.description: Process ID of the dotsider instance

commands.name: view
commands.description: Show current view state of a running instance

arguments.name: PID
arguments.description: Process ID of the dotsider instance

commands.name: size-check
commands.description: Compare AOT build size against a baseline and enforce size budgets

options.name: --baseline
options.description: Baseline binary or .mstat to diff against

options.name: --budget
options.description: Size budget (e.g. max=25mb or ns=System.Text.Json:growth=10kb); repeatable

options.name: --budget-file
options.description: JSON file with budgets ({ "budgets": [spec or object, ...] })

options.name: --top
options.description: Top contributors per section and per violated budget (default 10) [default: 10]

options.name: --why
options.description: Attach dependency chains for top added contributors (needs the target's DGML sidecar)

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text (default), json, or markdown

options.name: --summary-file
options.description: Additionally write the markdown report to a file (e.g. "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY")

options.name: --output
options.description: Write output to a file instead of stdout

arguments.name: TARGET
arguments.description: Native AOT binary or .mstat size report to check
